note.question: How do on-demand and reserved servers affect service systems?
note.overview: In many real-world applications, such as cloud computing, there is a growing trend to supplement long-term reserved capacity with short-term on-demand capacity. This paper studies a queueing system that employs both reserved and (relatively more expensive) on-demand servers. The number of reserved servers is decided at the beginning of the time horizon, while the number of on-demand servers is decided dynamically in real time.
